artworks.title: a u. c Thujopsis dolabrata; b Ruta graveolens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of three abstract organic forms. The photo is divided into three sections, each showcasing a separate close-up of a complex organic structure. The top and bottom sections show elongated, interlocking shapes that resemble a series of shells or seed pods, arranged in a curve. The central section displays two identical star-like formations side by side, each with radiating arms and a dense central part. The grayscale photograph emphasizes the textures and contrasts of these forms. The image number "67" is printed on the bottom right corner outside the border of the photo layout.

artworks.title: Parnassia palustris
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a symmetrical star-like flower with six petals and multiple protruding structures around its center. The color palette is monochrome, with the photo in black and white, showcasing the textures and details of the object. It is centrally positioned on the page with a dark background emphasizing its intricate details and symmetrical form.

artworks.title: Asclepias speciosa
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a symmetrical plant viewed from above, with elongated, pointed leaves spreading out from the center like a star. The color palette is grayscale, with shades of black, white, and gray. The plant is centrally positioned, occupying most of the page, and its leaves extend evenly around. The page displays the number '69' in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: a u. c Thujopsis dolabrata; b Solanum tuberosum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays three horizontal panels focusing on plant elements. The top and bottom panels feature elongated arrangements of seed pods or buds, while the middle panel contains two large flowers. The image is in black and white, showcasing shades of gray, black, and white. The first panel presents the elongated plant component at the top, while the middle panel shows two flowers side by side. The bottom panel mirrors the top with another horizontal arrangement of seed pods.

artworks.title: a Sanguisorba canadensis; b Vincetoxicum fuscatum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two monochromatic close-up photographs of plant stems. One stem has deeply serrated leaves, and the other stem features tightly wrapped leaf or bud formations in a spiral pattern. The color palette is grayscale. The layout shows the stem with serrated leaves on the left and the spiral-wrapped stem on the right. Both images are enclosed by a beige border, and the number 71 is in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Epimedium Muschianum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a flower or plant structure with a symmetrical arrangement. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of gray, highlighting the texture and details of the object. The flower is centrally positioned and fills most of the frame, with petal tips extending towards the edges. In the lower right corner, the number '72' is visible.

artworks.title: Cobaea scandens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed close-up of a flower with distinct petals and veining. The color palette is monochromatic in grayscale, highlighting the texture and structure of the petals. The flower fills the frame, with petals radiating outward from the center where an unopened bud is located. The flower stands out against a plain background, with the page number '73' visible at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Cobaea scandens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large, detailed flower in the center of the frame. The flower has prominent petals and a textured surface. The photo is in black and white, with various shades of gray. The flower fills most of the space in the frame, displaying intricate veins and smooth contours. The rest of the frame is plain. A page number "74" is visible in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Taraxacum officinale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a textured plant bud or seed pod in grayscale colors. The plant pod is centrally positioned in the frame, with a stem extending downward. It has ribbed textures on the surface and draped elements around its base.

artworks.title: Eranthis cilicica
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white close-up of a budding flower or plant. The structure includes a bulb-like base at the bottom with closed petals extending upwards. The center of the composition holds the plant, with a stem rising from the base and closed flower pointing towards the top left corner of the image. The petals have a textured surface.

artworks.title: Caphalaria
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large, spherical object resembling a seed or flower bud with a repeating pattern that resembles scales or overlapping petals, atop a slender stem. The color palette is monochromatic, rendered in shades of gray. Positioned centrally and occupying a significant portion of the frame, the textured object has intricate detailing that stands out against the uniform background. A stem extends vertically from the lower center of the image.

artworks.title: a Tragopogon porrifolius; b Muscari racemosum; c Thujopsis dolabrata
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features three large black and white close-up photographs of plant structures. The color palette is grayscale, with varying shades of black, white, and gray. The first object at the top is an elongated structure with overlapping segments. The second object in the middle is a cone-like cluster of rounded units. The third object at the bottom of the image resembles a star-shaped open flower or seed pod, with elongated, narrow petals extending outward. The photograph has a border and is numbered 78 at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Symphytum officinale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed, textured plant structure, possibly a seed pod or fruit, in grayscale. The plant occupies the center against a light gray background, showcasing its intricate surface details and shape. A white border surrounds the object.

artworks.title: Papaver orientale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a spiky plant bud with protruding leaves or bracts. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of grey. The bud is in the center of the image, with the plant's fibers and textures in the foreground and a lighter background providing contrast.

artworks.title: Asclepias syriaca
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a flower viewed from below, displaying its sepals and petals. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray, creating a vintage or black-and-white look. The flower is centered, with its stem reaching down from the bottom, and the petals are facing upwards.

artworks.title: Asclepias syriaca
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a flower with five large petals symmetrically arranged around its center. The color palette is black and white. The flower fills most of the space in the center with the tips of the petals extending towards the frame edges. The details of each petal and the flower's central structures are visible.

artworks.title: Serratula nudicaulis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three large artichokes in varying heights and positions. The color palette is monochrome, using tones of gray and black.

artworks.title: Cirsium canum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a close-up of an artichoke bud in black and white. The layers of petals are visible, and the texture and form of the artichoke are emphasized. The artichoke bud is centered in the image, with its stem seen at the bottom.

artworks.title: Tellima grandiflora
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a plant structure resembling a seed pod or flower bud with textured surfaces and thin, ribbon-like extensions at the top. The color palette is monochromatic, with tones of gray, black, and white. The pod is positioned centrally in the frame against a dark background, with extended portions reaching towards the edges.

artworks.title: Centaurea ruthenica
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large artichoke flower on its stem in black and white. The artichoke is centered and occupies most of the upper portion of the image, with the stem extending downwards towards the bottom edge.

artworks.title: Brunella grandiflora
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of a plant bud with textured petals and curved sepals. The photograph has a grayscale color palette. The vertical orientation of the plant stem positions the bud centrally, with the plant stem at the bottom extending upward to the top center of the image, where the detailed bud is featured. The sepals arch to the sides, creating a symmetrical appearance.

artworks.title: Symphytum officinale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed close-up of a floral structure with several tubular flowers attached to a branching stem. The flowers are presented in varying stages of bloom with some petals having pronounced darkness due to shadows or natural coloring of the photograph. The color palette is monochromatic, exhibiting shades of gray, black, and white as it is a black-and-white image. The stem and flowers point diagonally from the lower right corner towards the upper left, with the majority of blooms concentrated in the upper half of the image. The number "88" is visible in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Symphytum officinale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed close-up of a plant structure with elongated leaves branching out from a central stem. The color palette is monochrome, with various shades of gray. The plant is positioned horizontally, with the stem on the right side and the leaves fanning out downward. The background is clear, contrasting with the plant. A number "89" is faintly visible on the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Phacelia tanacetifolia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two large symmetrical objects resembling flower heads, positioned along the vertical axis. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring shades of gray. The top flower-like object is centered in the upper half of the image, and the bottom object is positioned in the lower half, connected by a central stem-like structure.
